# Multi-statement queries, whose result is that of the last statement to run. Expected values
# follow the procedural language reference:
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/procedural-language

## DECLARE and SET

# A variable without DEFAULT is NULL.
DECLARE x INT64;
SELECT x
=> null

DECLARE x ARRAY<INT64>;
SELECT x IS NULL
=> "true"

DECLARE x, y, z INT64 DEFAULT 0;
SELECT z
=> "0"

# Variable names are case-insensitive.
DECLARE Foo INT64 DEFAULT 1;
SELECT foo
=> "1"

# A DEFAULT may reference variables declared before it.
DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 2;
DECLARE y INT64 DEFAULT x * 3;
SELECT y
=> "6"

# A column takes precedence over a variable of the same name.
DECLARE a INT64 DEFAULT 100;
SELECT MAX(a) FROM t
=> "3"

DECLARE item DEFAULT (SELECT b FROM t WHERE a = 1);
SELECT item
=> "x"

DECLARE x INT64;
SET x = 5;
SELECT x
=> "5"

DECLARE a INT64;
DECLARE b STRING;
DECLARE c BOOL;
SET (a, b, c) = (1 + 3, 'foo', false);
SELECT a
=> "4"

DECLARE a INT64;
DECLARE b STRING;
DECLARE c BOOL;
SET (a, b, c) = (1 + 3, 'foo', false);
SELECT b
=> "foo"

DECLARE a INT64;
DECLARE b STRING;
DECLARE c BOOL;
SET (a, b, c) = (1 + 3, 'foo', false);
SELECT c
=> "false"

# The query's first column goes to the first variable, and its second to the second.
DECLARE lo, hi INT64;
SET (lo, hi) = (SELECT AS STRUCT MIN(a) AS smallest, MAX(a) AS largest FROM t);
SELECT hi
=> "3"

## BEGIN...END

DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 10;
BEGIN
  DECLARE y INT64;
  SET y = x;
  SELECT y;
END;
SELECT x;
=> "10"

## BEGIN...EXCEPTION...END

BEGIN
  SELECT 1/0;
EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
  SELECT @@error.statement_text;
END;
=> "SELECT 1/0"

# @@error.message matches the message RAISE gives.
BEGIN
  RAISE USING MESSAGE = 'oops';
EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
  SELECT @@error.message;
END;
=> "oops"

## CASE

DECLARE product_id INT64 DEFAULT 1;
CASE product_id
  WHEN 1 THEN
    SELECT CONCAT('Product one');
  WHEN 2 THEN
    SELECT CONCAT('Product two');
  ELSE
    SELECT CONCAT('Invalid product');
END CASE;
=> "Product one"

DECLARE target_product_id INT64 DEFAULT 2;
CASE
  WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE a = target_product_id) THEN SELECT 'found';
  ELSE SELECT 'did not find';
END CASE;
=> "found"

## IF

DECLARE target_product_id INT64 DEFAULT 103;
IF target_product_id IS NULL THEN
  -- Do nothing.
ELSE
  SELECT CONCAT('Product ID: ', CAST(target_product_id AS STRING));
END IF;
=> "Product ID: 103"

DECLARE target_product_id INT64 DEFAULT 103;
IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE a = target_product_id) THEN
  SELECT CONCAT('found product ', CAST(target_product_id AS STRING));
ELSE
  SELECT CONCAT('did not find product ', CAST(target_product_id AS STRING));
END IF;
=> "did not find product 103"

## Labels

label_1: BEGIN
  SELECT 1;
  BREAK label_1;
  SELECT 2; -- Unreached
END;
=> "1"

## Loops

DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 0;
LOOP
  SET x = x + 1;
  IF x >= 10 THEN
    LEAVE;
  END IF;
END LOOP;
SELECT x;
=> "10"

DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 0;
REPEAT
  SET x = x + 1;
  SELECT x;
  UNTIL x >= 3
END REPEAT;
=> "3"

DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 0;
WHILE x < 3 DO
  SET x = x + 1;
END WHILE;
SELECT x;
=> "3"

# CONTINUE returns to the start of the loop.
DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 0;
DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT 0;
WHILE x < 4 DO
  SET x = x + 1;
  IF MOD(x, 2) = 0 THEN
    CONTINUE;
  END IF;
  SET n = n + 1;
END WHILE;
SELECT n;
=> "2"

# Each row is a STRUCT of the query's columns.
DECLARE total INT64 DEFAULT 0;
FOR record IN (SELECT a, b FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL) DO
  SET total = total + record.a;
END FOR;
SELECT total;
=> "6"

## RETURN

SELECT 1;
RETURN;
SELECT 2;
=> "1"

## Temporary tables
# Expected values follow
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/multi-statement-queries#temporary_tables

CREATE TEMP TABLE n AS SELECT 5 AS x;
SELECT x FROM n
=> "5"

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE n (x INT64);
INSERT n (x) VALUES (1), (2);
UPDATE n SET x = x * 10 WHERE x = 2;
DELETE FROM n WHERE x = 1;
SELECT SUM(x) FROM n
=> "20"

# _SESSION names a temporary table explicitly.
CREATE TEMP TABLE _SESSION.n AS SELECT 6 AS x;
SELECT x FROM n
=> "6"

CREATE TEMP TABLE n AS SELECT 7 AS x;
SELECT x FROM _SESSION.n
=> "7"

# An unqualified name refers to a temporary table before a table of the default dataset.
CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT 10 AS a;
SELECT MAX(a) FROM t
=> "10"

CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT 10 AS a;
SELECT MAX(a) FROM scalars.t
=> "3"
